A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same Galaxy Walker research. Their complete main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–E are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original Galaxy Walker results for galaxy property estimation and morphology classification in Table 3, with additional experiments in Appendix D.

after.justification: V2 retains those original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparison and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: The Geometry Prompt, Geometry Adapter, prediction heads, and two-stage training procedure are unchanged. The implementation and prompt descriptions in the appendices also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use DESI-LS DR9, DESI EDR, and Galaxy Zoo DECaLS5 for the same four property-estimation tasks and ten morphology-classification tasks. No evaluated domain or scenario changes.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains the same Photometry, Stein, AstroCLIP, and general-purpose VLM comparisons. Appendix D.4 and Table 8 retain the same naively fine-tuned Qwen2-VL comparison.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, R2/F1 metrics, model configurations, preprocessing, and training settings are unchanged. This includes the property-estimation split of 84,121 training and 21,051 evaluation samples and Appendix A's settings.

E4.justification: The expert-contribution analysis, galaxy case studies, modality ablations, and adapter-density experiments are identical. Appendix D's prompt and training-strategy analyses are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 5 reports inference times averaged over 100 runs in both versions. No repeated-run, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are retained. For example, Table 3 gives Galaxy Walker property-estimation R2 scores of 0.91, 0.69, 0.52, and 0.84 in both versions; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13, including the manifold definitions and mappings in Appendix B, are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same geometry-aware modeling contributions, novelty positioning, and performance claims.

C2.justification: The geometric explanations of results and adapter-placement tradeoffs are unchanged. The limitations concerning model/expert scale and applicability beyond astronomical data remain in Section 5 and Appendix E.

D1.justification: V2's acknowledgement newly states that the work was developed on Openl Community, adding a limited development-platform disclosure. It supplies no new operational instructions and does not establish a change to the experimental setup.

R1.justification: The same 34 references and research-positioning discussion are retained. Reference 9 continues onto the next page in v2, but its bibliographic content is unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 adds one acknowledgement sentence and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose, section organization, and appendix text are unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer acknowledgement reflows the reference list on pages 9–10, splitting reference 9 across the page break. Figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 adds a brief development-platform credit and causes minor bibliography reflow. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, limitations, and substantive reproducibility guidance remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful net quality difference.
